title: Gunmen Open Fire at Church in Jordan, Killing Several People
summary_full: The attack took place during a funeral in the southern province of Karak, home to a longstanding Christian community, according to Jordan’s national police force. Security forces are pursuing the gunmen, the state broadcaster reported.
